problem.observed: After successful device OAuth in iPhone UI, Codespaces may return with an ordinary workspace terminal rather than the pre-OAuth audited clean shell.
problem.security_effect: Pre-OAuth shell functions/constants cannot be assumed to survive. Continuing, re-running Step 0 ad hoc, or selecting another terminal is forbidden operator invention under v3.

remediation_scope.principle: Do not require shell continuity across the iPhone OAuth UI boundary. Re-establish a new audited clean-shell epoch after OAuth and fully rehydrate/reverify the external trust root before any later repository Python entry.

exact_v4_overrides.step2_oauth_command_replacement: GH_BROWSER='/bin/true' gh auth login --hostname github.com --git-protocol https --web --scopes 'repo,read:org,gist'
step2_operator_ui_contract: Answer the existing Git credential question Yes.

When the CLI displays the one-time device code and asks to open the browser, press Enter. GH_BROWSER=/bin/true intentionally prevents an in-terminal/text browser from opening while allowing gh to enter its device-flow wait/poll path.

Complete https://github.com/login/device in a first-party iPhone GitHub UI. GitHub Mobile or the normal iPhone browser is allowed; do not enter GitHub username/password into a terminal or text browser and do not expose the one-time code to Core/chat.

Return to the same dedicated Codespace after GitHub reports the device is connected. The visible terminal MAY be an ordinary workspace shell; pre-OAuth clean-shell continuity is explicitly not trusted or required.
Do not run any repo command from that returned shell. Immediately perform the exact post-OAuth clean-shell reentry command and exact rehydration block below.
exact_v4_overrides.step2_5_post_oauth_clean_shell_reentry_e: \exec /usr/bin/env -i PATH='/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/local/python/current/bin' HOME='/dev/shm/multiverse-r1-stage1-phase-c-home' TERM='xterm-256color' LANG='C' LC_ALL='C' CODESPACES="${CODESPACES:-}" CODESPACE_NAME="${CODESPACE_NAME:-}" GH_CONFIG_DIR='/dev/shm/multiverse-r1-stage1-phase-c-gh-auth' PYTHONNOUSERSITE='1' /bin/bash --noprofile --norc
exact_v4_overrides.step2_6_post_oauth_rehydrate_and_reverif:
set +e
set +x
set -u
umask 077
CANONICAL_SHA='74ea95e59ac0654e1a0c1f811a178b3eef7b073c'
CANONICAL_ORIGIN='https://github.com/fufufu1116/multiverse-research.git'
EXEC_ROOT='/dev/shm/multiverse-r1-stage1-phase-c-execution'
EMPTY_TEMPLATE='/dev/shm/multiverse-r1-stage1-phase-c-empty-git-template'
SESSION_ROOT='/dev/shm/multiverse-r1-stage1-phase-c-session-state'
git_clean() {
  command env -i PATH='/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin' HOME="$HOME" LANG='C' LC_ALL='C' GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM='1' GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM='/dev/null' GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL='/dev/null' GIT_ATTR_NOSYSTEM='1' GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS='1' GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT='0' git "$@"
}
phase_c_verify() (
  set -eu -o pipefail
  test "${CODESPACES:-}" = 'true'
  test -n "${CODESPACE_NAME:-}"
  test "${GH_CONFIG_DIR:-}" = '/dev/shm/multiverse-r1-stage1-phase-c-gh-auth'
  test ! -L "$EXEC_ROOT"
  test "$(command stat -c '%a' "$EXEC_ROOT")" = '700'
  test "$(command stat -c '%u' "$EXEC_ROOT")" = "$(command id -u)"
  fs="$(command stat -f -c '%T' "$EXEC_ROOT")"; test "$fs" = 'tmpfs' || test "$fs" = 'ramfs'
  test -d "$EXEC_ROOT/.git"; test ! -L "$EXEC_ROOT/.git"
  test -d "$EXEC_ROOT/tools"; test ! -L "$EXEC_ROOT/tools"
  test "$(git_clean -C "$EXEC_ROOT" rev-parse --verify 'HEAD^{commit}')" = "$CANONICAL_SHA"
  if git_clean -C "$EXEC_ROOT" symbolic-ref -q HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 41; else test "$?" -eq 1; fi
  test "$(git_clean -C "$EXEC_ROOT" remote)" = 'origin'
  test "$(git_clean -C "$EXEC_ROOT" config --local --get remote.origin.url)" = "$CANONICAL_ORIGIN"
  if git_clean -C "$EXEC_ROOT" ls-files -v | command grep -q '^[a-z]'; then exit 42; fi
  if git_clean -C "$EXEC_ROOT" ls-files -t | command grep -q '^S '; then exit 43; fi
  for p in tools/multiverse_r1_stage1_phase_c_execution_preflight_v1.py tools/multiverse_r1_stage1_writer_key_provisioner_v1.py tools/multiverse_r1_stage1_writer_key_admin_channel_v1.py; do
    entry="$(git_clean -C "$EXEC_ROOT" ls-tree "$CANONICAL_SHA" -- "$p")"
    mode="${entry%% *}"; rest="${entry#* }"; type="${rest%% *}"; rest="${rest#* }"; oid="${rest%%$'\t'*}"; listed="${rest#*$'\t'}"
    test "$mode" = '100644'; test "$type" = 'blob'; test "$listed" = "$p"
    test -f "$EXEC_ROOT/$p"; test ! -L "$EXEC_ROOT/$p"; test ! -x "$EXEC_ROOT/$p"
    test "$(command stat -c '%h' "$EXEC_ROOT/$p")" = '1'
    test "$(command stat -c '%u' "$EXEC_ROOT/$p")" = "$(command id -u)"
    perm="$(command stat -c '%a' "$EXEC_ROOT/$p")"; (( (8#$perm & 022) == 0 ))
    test "$(git_clean -C "$EXEC_ROOT" hash-object --no-filters -- "$p")" = "$oid"
  done
  test -z "$(git_clean -C "$EXEC_ROOT" status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all)"
)
test -x '/usr/local/python/current/bin/python' || { command printf '%s\n' 'PHASE_C_POST_OAUTH_TRUSTED_PYTHON_BINARY_MISSING_STOP_DELETE_CODESPACE' >&2; exit 93; }
test "$(command -v python)" = '/usr/local/python/current/bin/python' || { command printf '%s\n' 'PHASE_C_POST_OAUTH_TRUSTED_PYTHON_RESOLUTION_MISMATCH_STOP_DELETE_CODESPACE' >&2; exit 93; }
for p in "$HOME" "$GH_CONFIG_DIR" "$EXEC_ROOT"; do
  test -d "$p" || { command printf '%s\n' 'PHASE_C_POST_OAUTH_MEMORY_ROOT_MISSING_STOP_DELETE_CODESPACE' >&2; exit 93; }
  test ! -L "$p" || { command printf '%s\n' 'PHASE_C_POST_OAUTH_MEMORY_ROOT_SYMLINK_STOP_DELETE_CODESPACE' >&2; exit 93; }
  test "$(command stat -c '%a' "$p")" = '700' || { command printf '%s\n' 'PHASE_C_POST_OAUTH_MEMORY_ROOT_MODE_MISMATCH_STOP_DELETE_CODESPACE' >&2; exit 93; }
  test "$(command stat -c '%u' "$p")" = "$(command id -u)" || { command printf '%s\n' 'PHASE_C_POST_OAUTH_MEMORY_ROOT_OWNER_MISMATCH_STOP_DELETE_CODESPACE' >&2; exit 93; }
  fs="$(command stat -f -c '%T' "$p")"; { test "$fs" = 'tmpfs' || test "$fs" = 'ramfs'; } || { command printf '%s\n' 'PHASE_C_POST_OAUTH_MEMORY_ROOT_NOT_RAMFS_STOP_DELETE_CODESPACE' >&2; exit 93; }
done
test "$(command awk 'END{print NR}' /proc/swaps)" = '1' || { command printf '%s\n' 'PHASE_C_POST_OAUTH_SWAP_PRESENT_STOP_DELETE_CODESPACE' >&2; exit 93; }
phase_c_verify
PHASE_C_POST_OAUTH_REVERIFY_RC=$?
if [ "$PHASE_C_POST_OAUTH_REVERIFY_RC" -ne 0 ]; then command printf '%s\n' "PHASE_C_POST_OAUTH_EXTERNAL_REVERIFY_FAILED_RC=$PHASE_C_POST_OAUTH_REVERIFY_RC" >&2; exit 93; fi
unset PHASE_C_POST_OAUTH_REVERIFY_RC
command printf '%s\n' 'PHASE_C_POST_OAUTH_CLEAN_SHELL_REENTRY_PASS'
exact_v4_overrides.later_steps: Only after the Step 2.6 PASS marker, run v2 Step 3 and Step 4 byte-for-byte unchanged. The post-OAuth shell epoch must remain the same through Step 3, Step 4, cleanup and local teardown.

trust_model_delta.pre_oauth_clean_shell_epoch: Step 0/0.5/1 and Step 2 command launch occur in the first audited clean shell.
trust_model_delta.oauth_boundary: Shell continuity across iPhone UI navigation is deliberately NOT a trust requirement.
trust_model_delta.post_oauth_clean_shell_epoch: After returning, the exact Step 2.5 env-i exec creates a fresh audited clean shell; Step 2.6 reconstructs constants/functions from frozen text and re-authenticates tmpfs roots, Python binding and exact checkout bytes before any repository Python entry.
trust_model_delta.same_shell_requirement: Required within each epoch; not required across the OAuth UI boundary. The second epoch is mandatory and dominates all later security-critical repository Python.
trust_model_delta.browser_suppression: GH_BROWSER=/bin/true removes the prior in-terminal/text-browser branch from the approved sequence.
trust_model_delta.failure: Any inability to complete OAuth, re-enter the clean shell, or obtain PHASE_C_POST_OAUTH_CLEAN_SHELL_REENTRY_PASS => STOP_NO_APPLY_DELETE_CODESPACE_RETURN_FOR_REVIEW. No retry in that session.

delivery_order: v4 Step 2 OAuth replacement and exact operator UI contract
only after PASS: unchanged v2 Step 3
only after Step 3 PASS and Fresh binding: unchanged v2 Step 4
